Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the commercial fisheries permit buyback account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to commercial fisheries; adding new sections tochapter 77.70 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commercial fisheries permit buyback account is created in thecustody of the state treasurer. All receipts from money collected bythe commission under section 2 of this act, moneys appropriated for thepurposes of this section, and other gifts, grants, or donationsspecifically made to the fund must be deposited into the account.Expenditures from the account may be used only for the purpose ofrepaying moneys advanced by the federal government under a fleetreduction, groundfish permit buyback program established by the federalgovernment. Only the director of fish and wildlife or the director'sdesignee may authorize expenditures from the account. The account issubject to allotment procedures under chapter 43.88 RCW, but anappropriation is not required for expenditures.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The fish and wildlife commission shall collect a fee frompersons holding an ocean pink shrimp delivery license issued under RCW77.65.390, a Dungeness crabcoastal fishery license issued under RCW77.70.280, or a salmon troll license issued under RCW 77.65.160 torepay the federal government for moneys advanced by the federalgovernment under a fleet reduction, groundfish permit buyback programestablished by the federal government. (2) The commission shall adopt a fee schedule by rule for thecollection of the fee required by subsection (1) of this section. Thefee schedule adopted shall limit the total amount of moneys collectedthrough the fee to the minimum amount necessary to repay the moneysadvanced by the federal government. Additionally, the commission shalladjust the fee schedule such that the money collected from each personholding an ocean pink shrimp delivery license issued under RCW77.65.390, a Dungeness crabcoastal fishery license issued under RCW77.70.280, or a salmon troll license issued under RCW 77.65.160 isproportional to the benefits derived from the permit buyback program bypersons holding permits issued under the following statutes: (a) Ocean troll salmon fishery; (b) Ocean pink shrimp fishery; and (c) Ocean Dungeness crab fishery. (3) The commission shall deposit moneys collected under thissection in the commercial fisheries permit buyback account created insection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The fish and wildlife commission may not assess the fee specifiedunder section 2 of this act until after the federal government createsthe fleet reduction, groundfish permit buyback program.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Sections 1 through 3 of this act expire January 1, 2006. (2) Any balance in the commercial fisheries permit buyback account HB 1887 p. 2 that is unexpended and unobligated on January 1, 2006, and all moneysthat would have been deposited in the account must be deposited in thegeneral fund.
